_readme: Dobie Twenty21, 2021 Guadalupe St, as js/slopes-apartments.js draws it. Every number cites a source key from `sources` in a sibling `_src` field; a value with no source says so. Metres, in the footprint's own oriented bounding box (js/westcampus.js obbOf): +u runs WEST along West 21st St (bearing 275.1°), +v runs SOUTH; u=0 is the EAST edge (the service yard and the Whitis Ave lot), u=80.5 the WEST edge on Guadalupe, v=0 the NORTH edge on West 21st St, v=63.0 the south edge. L=80.5 m, W=63.0 m. Read docs/apartments.md for the schema.
name: Dobie Twenty21

sources.S1: OSM way 42807636 (Overpass, 2026-09-05): building=yes, name=Dobie Twenty21, alt_name D21, addr 2025 Guadalupe Street, building:levels=31, start_date=1972, wikidata Q5286585, wikipedia en:Dobie Center. Its ring is the same 15 vertices as the snapshot polygon (S2) — the City of Austin import both came from.
sources.S2: data/snapshots/2026-08-27/buildings.detailed.geojson feature 0e189df9-9783-442e-be10-5ad33510e9d9: the 15-vertex footprint, num_floors 31, final_height 82.0, source_height hero_override. The override is scripts/hero_overrides.json {"match_name":"Dobie Twenty21","height":82.0,"note":"27 floors."}.
sources.S3: OSM way 516187626: building:part=dormitory, name "Dobie Twenty21 Student Spaces", building:min_level=2, building:levels=29, height=94, start_date 1972. Its 20-vertex ring is the TOWER plan and is used verbatim below; its 94 m height is not (see levels._height_src).
sources.S4: OSM way 724758494: leisure=swimming_pool, location=roof, name "Dobie Skyline Pool" — the pool is on the podium deck. Its ring is ~3.5 m off the water in the rectified nadir (S7) so the pool rectangle below is measured off the imagery, not taken from this way; the way is what says the pool is a roof pool at all.
sources.S5: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dobie_Center (infobox + body, read 2026-09-05): Dobie Center / Dobie Twenty21, 2021 Guadalupe Street, floor_count 27, architect J. & G. Daverman and Associates, 1972, six elevators, owned by UT since 2021; 'a two-story mall, restaurants, and specialty stores'; 'The building underwent a US$10 million facelift in 1990 to replace its then brick façade by exposing the glass underneath' (Daily Texan, Jan 11 1989) — which is why this is the only curtain wall in the West Campus group; 'a fire ... broke out on the pool deck ... The pool deck reopened in late April 2008 ... replaced by a concrete structure'.
sources.S6: commons.wikimedia.org File:Austin August 2019 02 (Dobie Center).jpg (4000x6000, read at 1920x2880), the whole building from the Guadalupe/21st corner looking at one tower face nearly square on: the teal curtain wall with a dark spandrel at every floor and a re-entrant fold down the middle of the face, the stepped notched crown, the white painted brick ground floor with tall narrow slot openings and square garage openings, the two-storey dark bronze glazed mall above it set back behind a terrace with a white pipe rail and planters, the steel trellis over that terrace, the tenant sign band, the canopy and neon over the Dobie Market door.
sources.S6m: measurements made on S6 by the projective method (the tower is a prism, so its silhouette width w(y) is pure perspective): w(y) = 750.3 + 0.2417 y px, fitted at y = 400/700/1000/1300/1600 (847/917/994/1066/1137 px); vertical lines vanish at y = -3104, so f/tan(phi) = 4544 px about the 1440 px centre; a ~90 deg vertical field (pavement at the photographer's feet to an 82 m top ~40 m away) puts f = 1433 px and phi = 17.5 deg. Then height is affine in y/w(y): the 23 spandrel lines detected between y=185 and y=1664 in the column x=600..640 span 57.8 m, i.e. 2.63 m floor to floor; the curtain-wall module is the 57.0 px horizontal period at y=1010, i.e. 1.79 m against a 31.1 m face-on silhouette; the parapet's low step is 1.3 m above the top floor line.
sources.S7: Google Earth 3D, captured 2026-09-05 with scripts/verify/chrome.mjs (hardware GL, page.screenshot): nadir @30.28335,-97.74135,175a,330d,35y,0h,0t, rectified into this (u,v) frame at 0.160 m/px (scale bar 187.5 px = 30 m) and resampled at 10 px/m — data/roads.geojson's Guadalupe, West 21st and Whitis centrelines land on their own roadways in the same projection, which is what says the frame is right; obliques at 300 m/55 deg from the NW (135h), SW (45h) and NE (225h). Imagery date 12/2023.
sources.S8: scripts/bake_westcampus.py BUILDINGS['Dobie Twenty21'] and its comment block: 1972, J. & G. Daverman, '27-storey tower on a two-level mall + garage podium', 'the 1990 retrofit stripped the brick and left the green vision glass, so this is the only curtain wall in the group'; base=(6.0,'sp',MASONRY #cfc9be), podium=(3,3.6,'dk','#c8c2b7') i.e. a podium top at 16.8 m, tower ('tg', '#5f7a80'), crown=(5.0,'sf',CROWN_TEAL #4f6268), mech 4.5, deck='podium', pool/turf/court rectangles; and the tower-plan note that OSM way 516187626 is '100.0% inside this footprint and is therefore a usable ground truth for the tower's plan: minimum rotated rectangle 31.15 x 31.50 m, diagonal 44.3 m, area 867 m2, edges at 39.3 deg'.
sources.S9: js/westcampus.js SOLID: the West Campus pass's day/golden/night trios, entered cool for top faces and dark at night. `turf` and `court` are labelled '(Dobie)' in that table — they were entered for this building's own deck.
sources.S10: data/hero_designs.json buildings['Dobie Twenty21']: wall #a2865a, trim #bda578, roof #6e5a3d, night_window #f0cb86, confidence 'known', notes 'Bronze-gold reflective glass tower'. NOT used for the tower: S5's 1990 reglazing and S6's own pixels say green-teal, and S8 agrees. The bronze reading fits the MALL glazing, which is where it is used.
sources.derived: a number computed from the above and marked so; 'unknown' stays unknown.

footprint._not_the_building: THIS RING IS THE PARCEL, NOT THE BUILT ENVELOPE, and no block below stands on it. Overlaid on the rectified nadir (S7) its north edge lies in West 21st Street, its east edge in a surface car park, its south edge on a service yard and its west edge in the Guadalupe sidewalk; the roofs stop at about u 8.5..72.5, v 6.5..57.5. The roads overlay rules out a georeferencing offset — the road centrelines land on their own roadways in the same projection. So the ring is kept verbatim (it is what defines the frame, and it is the polygon the generator filters out) and every block's plan is a (u,v) polygon measured off the imagery instead. The v-shaped notch at u 7..16, v 18..27 IS real: the nadir shows the garage entry court there.

_frame_src: obbOf(ring) as js/westcampus.js computes it: L=80.52, W=63.00, +u bearing 275.1° (west along West 21st St). u=0 is the east edge, v=0 the north (21st St) edge.

levels._src: 27 floor lines for 27 storeys (S5): the ground floor at 0 (Dobie Market, Target, the garage openings), the mall floor at 6.6 — the mall is the two-storey one (S5) and these are its two levels — and 25 residential floors from the podium deck at 15.8 up at 2.63 m each (S6m). Ground and mall heights derived from the total: 15.8 split 6.6 / 9.2, the taller half being the double-height glazed mall volume S6 shows.
levels._height_src: 82.0 m, the snapshot's own final_height (S2, hero_overrides 'Dobie Twenty21 82.0 — 27 floors'). RECONCILING S3's 94: OSM's building:part carries height=94 with building:levels=29 above building:min_level=2, i.e. 31 levels for the whole building, and the whole-building way (S1) says 31 too. Both contradict the sourced 27 storeys (S5). Measured on the photograph (S6m) the floor pitch is 2.63 m and 23 floor lines span 57.8 m; 25 residential floors at that pitch is 63.1 m, which under an 82.0 m top and a 3.1 m crown puts the podium deck at 15.8 m — within 1.0 m of the 16.8 m podium top the West Campus bake reads independently for this building (S8). 94 m would need either 2.63 m floors and a 28 m podium, or a 3.1 m dorm floor; neither is in any source. So 82.0 stands, and it also keeps js/controls.js's collision field, js/shadows.js and the labels on the number the rest of the app already uses.
levels._floorpitch_src: 2.63 m (S6m). 8 ft 7 in floor to floor is ordinary for a 1972 residence hall; it is measured here, not assumed.

colours._src: day hex; golden and night come from js/westcampus.js's ramp() unless a full trio is given.

glassTeal._src: the vision glass. 3-means on the tower field in S6 (x 430..1100, y 600..1400) returns #283c47 (29.6%), #475b67 (34.6%) and #90b1b6 (35.7%); the bright cluster is the sky-reflecting pane. Entered one step down from it because S6 is a flat overcast frame and the pane there is carrying the whole sky.

spandrel._src: the dark spandrel panel plus its mullions, between the two dark clusters of the same 3-means (#283c47 and #475b67, S6). A field of this at 45% behind glassTeal at 55% averages near #6b8489, which is what the West Campus bake's own tower colour #5f7a80 (S8) reads as from the same distance — so the mesh and the fill-extrusion bands next door do not disagree.

crown._src: CROWN_TEAL (S8): 'Dobie's dark spandrel, carried into the notched cap'.

masonry._src: MASONRY (S8): 'pale painted masonry base: Dobie, Castilian, Cambridge'. The same wall in S6 clusters at #989596 — that is this brick under a flat overcast sky in its own shade, and S8's value is the lifted one the rest of the pass uses.

masonryTrim._src: the recessed brick reveals beside the ground-floor slots read about a step darker than the field in S6; derived from masonry, not separately sampled.

mallFrame._src: the mall's dark bronze mullion grid: the dominant cluster (67.5%) of a 3-means on the glazed box band in S6 (x 360..1250, y 1780..2230).

steel._src: the trellis over the terrace and the ground-floor canopy, median of S6 at x 500..900, y 1720..1745.

coping._src: parapet coping aluminium; the same value The Standard uses (STD_CAP), not separately sampled.

colours._glass_src: the punched openings in the painted brick — the ground floor's tall slots read near-black in S6, darker than the brick beside them; night is the unlit pane, lit panes take APARTMENTS.nightLitTone.
colours._mallGlass_src: the mall's glazing: dark by day in S6, and the one part of this building that glows warm after dark — a food court behind a two-storey window wall. The night value is S10's own bronze-gold reading (#a2865a lifted), which is where that hero colour actually belongs.
colours._voidDark_src: the square garage openings on the north and east ground floor in S6: an unglazed hole into a dark deck, so it stays dark at night; entered flat, not sampled.
colours._roof_src: the white membrane roofs in the nadir (S7), entered cool the way S9 enters top faces.
colours._turf_src: S9 turf — the table names it '(Dobie)'
colours._court_src: S9 court — the table names it '(Dobie)'; the nadir (S7) shows the red court at u 10..20, v 41..49
colours._furn_src: S9 furn — the lawn's wooden loungers and cornhole boards in the nadir (S7)
colours._rail_src: S9 rail. NOTE the terrace rail in S6 is a WHITE pipe rail, not black steel; drawn here in S9's `raill` value instead — see railWhite.
colours._railWhite_src: S9 raill (precast / white metal parapet): the white pipe rail along the terrace in S6
colours._mech_src: S9 mech (mechanical penthouse screen); the two large round fan units at u 11..18, v 50..57 and the bulkheads on the tower roof in the nadir (S7)

skins._src: each skin is a rule; its numbers are below with their source

curtain._src: the tower's curtain wall. Module 1.79 m (S6m: the 57.0 px horizontal period at y=1010 against a 31.1 m face-on silhouette); the pane 1.35 m of that with a 0.44 m mullion pier, read off the same strip. Window 1.45 m tall with its head 2.60 m above the floor line leaves a 1.18 m spandrel band under the next floor, which is the proportion S6 shows. Reveal 0.05: a curtain wall is nearly flush, not a punched window.

crown._src: the notched cap (S8's CROWN_TEAL band): in S6 the parapet steps up in stages to a peak over the middle of each face. The STEPS are not drawn — this is one flush band at the height of the low step's top. Unmeasured: the step pattern.

brick._src: the painted brick ground floor on the two street frontages: tall narrow slot openings about a third of a bay wide, running from roughly a door's height above grade to just under the fascia, in a wall of pale painted brick with a recessed reveal at each pier. Scaled in S6 against the 2.13 m Dobie Market door; the bay is derived from the slot rhythm, not dimensioned.

garage._src: the row of large square unglazed openings in the same painted brick on the north-east stretch and round the service side (S6, right of the corner): a parking deck behind a masonry screen (S8 calls the podium a mall + garage).

storefront._src: the shopfront stretches at the Guadalupe/21st corner in S6 (Dobie Market under its canopy and neon, the Target frontage): full-height glazing on ~1.6 m mullions under a painted-brick fascia.

mall._src: the two-storey glazed mall volume (S5 'two-story mall'): a heavy dark bronze mullion grid on about a 2.1 m module with a strong horizontal at mid height, a deep dark fascia at the top under the trellis, and a solid band at its base — the tenant sign band (NAVY, Regus, Subway, Gong Cha, Oma's Kitchen ...) in S6. The sign panels themselves are not drawn.

screen._src: the podium's back and side elevations, which no photograph found here shows: given the plainest rule this building has — the same painted masonry, louvred where the garage decks are. Louvre pitch 0.55 is a plausible number, not measured (unknown).

mechScreen._src: the mall's high-bay walls above the deck, grey in the nadir (S7); unphotographed from the ground

blocks._src: the ground floor: painted brick to the back of the sidewalk on both streets, 0 to 6.6. Plan measured off the rectified nadir (S7) — the built envelope, NOT the parcel ring (see footprint._not_the_building). Its roof at 6.6 is the terrace the mall stands back behind, with the white pipe rail and planters S6 shows.

faces._src: v0 = the West 21st Street front and u1 = the Guadalupe front, both the photographed painted brick with slot openings (S6). u0 (the east service side, on to the car park) and v1 (the south service yard) are the garage screen: the nadir (S7) shows parked cars and a loading yard against both, and S8 calls the podium a mall + garage.

overrides._src: the shopfront stretch on 21st St west of the Dobie Market door (S6)
the shopfront stretch down Guadalupe from the corner — Dobie Market and the Target frontage (S6)

blocks._parapet_src: a low upstand round the terrace on the two street sides; the guard is the white pipe rail in roofItems (S6). Height 0.4 is a look.

roofItems._src: S6: the white pipe rail along the 21st St terrace, on the ground floor's roof in front of the mall's glass
S6: the same rail turning the corner and running down the Guadalupe terrace
S6: the planters of bougainvillea spaced along the 21st St terrace behind the rail

blocks._src: the two-storey glazed mall volume (S5), set back from the ground floor's face so the terrace runs in front of it: 4.0 m back on 21st St and 1.5 m on the other three sides, read off the rectified nadir (S7). 6.6 to 15.8; its roof is the amenity deck.

faces._src: the glazed box wraps the two street frontages in S6; the east and south sides face the service yard and the car park and no photograph found here shows them, so they wear the plainest rule this building has (masonry with garage louvres).

blocks._parapet_src: the deck's own upstand, on every edge — the nadir (S7) shows a light parapet line round the whole podium roof. 0.9 is a look.

roofItems._src: S7 nadir: the two large round fan units and their housings at u 11..19, v 50..57
S7 nadir: a condenser row on the east deck between the court and the lawn

blocks._src: the west and south half of the mall roof stands about 2.6 m above the pool deck and carries a run of parallel ridged monitor roofs — the nadir (S7) reads them as grey-green standing-seam ridges at u 50..72, v 25..50 with a white flat roof and mechanical plant at u 47..72, v 49..58. Height derived: they sit a storey below the deck's own parapet in the NW oblique (S7).

faces._src: v1 and u1 stand on the mall's own parapet line at v=57.5 and u=72.5 and are not drawn twice; v0 faces the pool deck and u0 the tower.

roofItems._src: S7 nadir: five parallel ridged monitor roofs running north-south over the mall's high bay. Drawn as low boxes, not as pitched ridges — the generator has no pitched-roof rule and this file adds none.
S7 nadir: the mechanical field on the white flat roof at the south-west

blocks._src: the 25-storey residential tower (S5: 27 storeys less the two mall levels), 15.8 to 80.22. Plan is OSM way 516187626 (S3) verbatim in this frame — a 31.1 x 31.1 m square turned 44.7 deg off the block grid with a 10.2 m wide, 1.9 m deep recess in the middle of each side, area 861 m2, centroid (30.83, 31.81). It lands on the tower roof in the rectified nadir (S7), and S8's own reading of the same way (31.15 x 31.50 m, diagonal 44.3 m, 867 m2, edges at 39.3 deg) agrees. The recess is the re-entrant fold that reads as a chevron down the middle of every face in S6.
blocks._faces_src: every one of the 20 edges wears the curtain wall: S6 shows the same module and the same spandrel line turning every corner and running through the fold, and the tower stands free above the podium on all four sides.

roofItems._src: S7 nadir: the bulkheads and plant enclosures on the tower roof, four blocks round the lift core. Kept under the crown's 82.0 top so nothing stands above the snapshot's final_height.

blocks._src: the notched cap (S8's crown band, CROWN_TEAL): 80.22 to 82.0 on the tower's own plan. In S6 the parapet steps up in stages toward a peak over the middle of each face; drawn here as one flush dark band at the height of the low step. The step pattern is unmeasured.

deck._src: the amenity deck on the mall roof — the pool deck S5 says burned in 2006 and reopened in 2008 as a concrete structure, and S4's roof pool. Every rectangle below is read off the rectified nadir (S7) in this frame at 10 px/m.

items._src: S7 nadir: the water, 6.0 x 10.3 m. S4's OSM way sits ~3.5 m off it and is not used for the rectangle.
S7 nadir: a small round tub east of the pool, drawn square
S7 nadir: the artificial lawn on the north-east deck, the part clear of the tower
S7 nadir: the lawn continuing west, trimmed where the tower's north-east face cuts it
S7 nadir: the last strip of lawn north of the tower's north corner
S7 nadir: the wooden loungers and cornhole boards scattered over the lawn, drawn as one low plate
S7 nadir: the red sport court on the east deck; S9's `court` trio was entered for it
S7 nadir: the grey structure standing in the middle of the court
S7 nadir: the green surround between the court and the tower's east corner
S6: the steel trellis over the 21st St terrace, cantilevered off the top of the mall's glazing. Drawn as a plate at the top of the glass; its posts and rafters are not drawn.
S6: the same trellis turning the Guadalupe corner

_open: The crown's steps are not drawn — S6 shows the parapet rising in stages to a peak over the middle of each face and the cap here is one flush band.

The tower's corners are chamfered in S6 (the narrow facet at each silhouette edge reads at about 45 deg to the front face) and in S8's own chamfered_square; OSM's way (S3) has sharp corners and is what is drawn. A chamfer of 2-3 m is the likely size and is unmeasured.
The mall's glazed box is canted across the Guadalupe/21st corner in S6; drawn here as a square corner.
The tenant sign band along the base of the mall glazing (S6) is not drawn; nor is the Dobie Market canopy and neon.

The ground floor's plan is a rectangle. The real envelope has a garage entry court on the east (the notch in the parcel ring, u 7..16 v 18..27) and a landscaped south-west corner on Guadalupe, both visible in S7 and both flattened here.
The mall's high-bay monitors are drawn as flat boxes; they are pitched ridges in S7.
